ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominance covering approximately 92% of the visible surface area against low-intensity black pixels localized at the boundaries and focal spots.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark circular mark/lesion on the extreme upper-right lobe tip and irregular dark pigmentation along the lower fluke join.
